Class Date

java.lang.Object
common.Date
public class Date extends Object
Stores a calendar date and a day code that can be used to compare dates. The day code counts days relative to January 1, 1900.

    • Date

      public Date()
      Creates the default date January 1, 1900.

    • Date

      public Date(int annual, int lunar, int daily)
      Creates a date after checking that the year, month, and day are valid.
      Parameters:
      annual - the year, starting at year 1
      lunar - the month number, from 1 through 12
      daily - the day number within the month
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the date is invalid or outside the supported day-code range

  • Method Details

    • setDate

      public void setDate(int annual, int lunar, int daily)
      Validates and stores a new date, then calculates its day code. Values are checked before fields are changed, so a failed update leaves the existing date intact.
      Parameters:
      annual - the year, starting at year 1
      lunar - the month number, from 1 through 12
      daily - the day number valid for that month and year
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any part of the date is invalid
